concepts.title: Shared desktop site frame
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: one high-fidelity visual design study of the shared desktop header and footer, around 1440 by 1200. Pure visual concept; no implementation code.
Input images: 1 and 2 are original authentic Software and Consulting brand-logo ARTWORK references. Preserve their S symbols, colors, names and proportions. Images 3, 4 and 5 are approved homepage STYLE REFERENCES for editorial calm, typography and whitespace; do not reproduce their full pages, large illustrations or old mastheads/footers.
Primary request: design one reusable shared page frame for all four company websites. Show the compact header at the very top and the generous common footer lower down, at readable scale, as one continuous website excerpt with no browser or device frame.
INVARIANT SHARED CONTENT AND STYLE:
This one frame is shared by Software, Open Source, Skills and Consulting with the SAME geometry, link order, background, spacing and typography. Only a subtle active-site marker changes. The frame is neutral warm-white #fbfaf9 / light neutral gray #f5f6f5, graphite #303033. Teal and berry occur in the authentic brand marks and restrained brand-specific link details. Do not wash the entire footer in blue, pink, beige or black. No dark blocks, diagonal section edges, giant headings, shadow cards, ornamental eyebrow labels or illustrations in the footer. Broad deliberate whitespace and a coherent invisible column grid.
Typography: light/regular humanist sans body and links; normal/book serif for functional footer headings, at a moderate scale. Preserve the original wordmark artwork and its actual logo typography, which is separate from page typography.
DESKTOP GLOBAL BAR: exactly 48 CSS pixels tall at a 1440 CSS-pixel viewport, one single compact row, centered 1280px content area, no wrapped second row. Software group on the left: small authentic teal S icon, "Software" brand-home link, then "Products", "Open Source", "Skills". Consulting group farther right: small authentic berry S icon, "Consulting" brand-home link, then "Services", "Profiles". "EN / DE" on the far right. Every item aligns on one baseline. Regular 13–14px navigation labels, brand-root labels about 14px, icons 20px tall. Current site has a subtle short 2px underline and slightly darker ink, no filled pills. The Software and Consulting groups have equal visual rank. One very quiet bottom hairline is sufficient.
FOOTER: a generous editorial footer approximately 560–660 CSS pixels high on desktop. Use matching side margins and four aligned columns, no card outlines. About 80–96px top and bottom breathing room; links use comfortable 30–34px line spacing; blank space separates related clusters. One quiet bottom legal row.
Column 1 COMPANY AND CONTACT:
"Sebastian Software GmbH"
"Dalheimer Straße 12"
"55128 Mainz"
"Germany"
Then a spacious pause:
"Mainz & Heidelberg"
"Rhine-Main · Rhine-Neckar"
Then contact links:
"info@sebastian-software.de"
"+49 6131 9729 830"
Column 2 SOFTWARE:
Authentic complete Software logo from input image 1, transparent/backgroundless, about 215–230px wide, equal optical height to the Consulting logo. Do not include its original colored reference rectangle.
Below: "Products", "Open Source", "Skills", "Company", "Journal".
Column 3 CONSULTING:
Authentic complete Consulting logo from input image 2, transparent/backgroundless, matching the Software logo's optical size. No colored reference rectangle.
Below: "Services", "Profiles", "References", "Book an intro call".
Column 4 NEWSLETTER:
Moderate regular serif heading "Newsletter"
Useful sentence "Product releases, open-source updates and engineering notes."
One quiet email field labeled "Email address" and a compact "Subscribe" action. The field and button are the only functional bordered controls in the footer. The button uses neutral graphite, not a loud pink or teal banner. No invented cadence, subscribers, claims, checkboxes or provider badges.
BOTTOM ROW:
Left "© 2026 Sebastian Software GmbH"
Right "Imprint", "Privacy", "Contact"
This row uses quiet small sans text and a generous gap above, at most one thin dividing line. No fabricated legal addresses, a second Heidelberg street address, social media handles, customer stories, case-study claims or invented logos.

COMPOSITION FOR THIS DESKTOP STUDY:
The 48px header starts at the top. Mark Software as current. Beneath it show only a quiet short excerpt of the approved Software page: moderate regular serif "Independent software. Built for everyday work." with the actual useful supporting sentence "We build products we use ourselves, from appointment booking to translation and local websites." Maintain broad side margins. Keep this body excerpt compact, about 200–240px high. Leave around 100px of neutral empty paper to convey the page's content-to-footer breathing room, then the complete 560–660px footer. Do not squeeze the footer to fit. Do not add placeholder labels such as Page content, Header, Footer, 48px, Desktop or design annotations inside the site.
Prioritize readable navigation and the exact real company/contact data. The two brands must appear equal, with the SAME common neutral frame rather than a Software-footer variant or a pink Consulting-footer variant.
Return one complete coherent visual mockup, with all footer columns and bottom links visible.

Germany

Products / Open Source / Skills / Company / Journal

Keep neutral near-white lightly textured paper, graphite ink, true teal/berry brand accents, the subtle top/footer legal hairlines, and equal brand prominence. No pink/beige/blue full-footer wash, dark banner, fake icons, photos, other illustrations or extra text. Return one complete image with the genuinely compact bar and all footer content visible.

concepts.title: Mobile website switcher
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: a focused mobile navigation state showing the OPEN common website switcher, 412 CSS pixels wide and approximately 680 CSS pixels high, one coherent mobile website view with no browser or device frame.
Input image 1: approved common desktop frame STYLE REFERENCE. Images 2 and 3: authentic Software and Consulting logo ARTWORK references.
Primary request: show how the shared 48px mobile header reveals the links to all four company sites. This is the opened state of the same header, not a new full-screen app or a separate search interface.
Keep neutral near-white subtly tactile paper, graphite regular/light humanist sans, normal/book serif when needed, and small true teal/berry brand details. No dark scrim, pink page wash, shadow card grid or large hero.
TOP BAR, 48 CSS PIXELS HIGH:
Left the authentic small teal S mark, "Software", and an UP-chevron as one trigger. Right "EN / DE". Same positions and small scale as the closed mobile header. One quiet bottom boundary. No extra hamburger.
OPEN MENU PANEL beneath the bar:
A broad clean neutral paper menu extends downward inside 24px left/right margins, with generous internal gaps. The panel can have very gently softened lower corners and a nearly invisible shadow, but no hard colored container.
First group: authentic full Sebastian Software logo, modest width around 190–210px, transparent reference background removed. The logo itself links to the Software homepage and gets a small quiet current-site underline. Beneath it, open readable rows "Products", "Open Source", "Skills", each around 44 CSS pixels tall, with small right-pointing arrows where helpful.
A generous empty pause, rather than a heavy divider.
Second group: authentic full Sebastian Consulting logo, matching the Software logo's optical size. The logo itself links to the Consulting homepage. Beneath it, readable rows "Services", "Profiles" with the same rhythm.
Keep every destination visible. Software and Consulting are two equal brands; Open Source and Skills sit beneath Software, not as invented standalone logos.
Below the panel, show only a small quiet glimpse of the underlying Software page headline, softened but still on light paper. The menu does not need a newsletter or a repeated footer in this focused state.
Preserve exact names and original S shapes. No login, cart, search, fake social accounts or extra services. Return one complete mobile open-menu state.
